outer_lock.rule: No V1.50 feature, model, threshold, gating, calibration, or selection decision may read 2025-2026 outcome labels. The already-visible V1.49 outer is immutable and is not reused as a V1.50 test set.

general_direction.origin: exact Twelve Data XAU/USD 1min 16:59 America/New_York observation; decision time NY17 after that completed bar

G1_ROLE_CONTEXT: FAST frozen SMA20 plus two-completed-origin persistence
SLOW completed-week close/SMA4 plus two-completed-week persistence
MONTHLY_DIRECTION_3M last three completed monthly returns

source_semantics.G2_RATES_FX_PIT: available_as_of <= origin is mandatory and is promotion-eligible only if lineage checks pass
source_semantics.G3_EQUITY_LAG1_RECONSTRUCTION: historical economic-date reconstruction only; one-origin lag mandatory; current backfill retrieval timestamps do not prove historical PIT availability
source_semantics.G4_PRECIOUS_LAG1_RECONSTRUCTION: historical research reconstruction only; one-origin lag mandatory; not promotion-eligible without prospective source clock proof

general_direction.missingness: Train-only median imputation with missingness indicators for logistic models; native/matched missing handling for tree model. No full-block complete-case deletion.
general_direction.selection: For each horizon, select feature-set/model pair using only sequential predictions whose origins are on or before 2024-06-30. Primary selection metric Brier score; log loss is tie-breaker.

selective_prediction.selection_rule: Use only selection-window predictions. Choose the threshold with highest directional accuracy subject to coverage >= 0.35 and accepted_n >= 20; break ties by higher coverage then lower threshold.
selective_prediction.interpretation: NO_SIGNAL is allowed when the frozen threshold is not met.

event_direction.role: Sparse event-time specialist; never merged onto the unconditional NY17 evaluation clock
event_direction.score_direction: sign(score) is the gold-oriented expected initial reaction direction; zero score is NO_SIGNAL
event_direction.strong_state_rule: Existing frozen metadata state only; no new threshold is chosen from V1.50 outcomes
event_direction.market_shock_role: MARKET_SHOCK_CHALLENGER_V3 is confirmation/context only, not an unconditional 1D/3D vote
event_direction.continuation_rule: Initial reaction and post-shock continuation/reversal are separate targets and must never be relabelled as the same task

governance.allowed_outcome: development evidence may only nominate a frozen prospective shadow candidate
